title: 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing
subtitle: Fang Hu Sheng Ching (Elevated Region of the Square Pot) · Yuanming Yuan

model.line: The towers on their terraces over the water as the leaf of 1744 paints them and S01 draws them: nine two-storey towers in three ranges (S05, S361, Malone), the lower terrace with its stepped bastions on the water, the upper brick-faced terrace, the galleries joining the towers' upper floors, the causeway with its two archways to 迎薰亭 and the two cruciform terraces with 集瑞亭 and 凝祥亭; S01 gives the layout (B), the leaf the storeys, roofs, colours and parts (A for 1744), the texts the names; every height, every bay's width and the ornaments are C.
rows: As S01 draws it, re-read in Round 24 in plan pixels (B): the lower terrace on the water and its bastions, the upper terrace behind it, three ranges each of a five-bay middle block and two side towers, the galleries, the strips out to the two cross terraces, the causeway and the square terrace; the bastions' line matches the ruin's today (P0383, P0787)
The inlet the terraces stand in (S01; the leaf), water in the ground since Round 24 (W0365; Q191); its level the rule of Round 10 (C)

The front range: five bays on two floors (S05 上下各五楹, A), a skirt roof and a balcony between them, 歇山 in yellow tile with green trim, red columns and lattice (the leaf, A for 1744); the three-bay entry before it, one storey under the upper floor's balcony (S01, the leaf; bays C); the plaque 方壶胜境 over its door (S05; board C)
锦绮楼 and 翡翠楼 (the 1740 plaques, S310; which is which C): two storeys, 歇山 with their gables to the water, yellow with green trim (the leaf); S01's blocks

On the upper terrace (Malone: brick-faced; S05 其北樓宇為噦鸞殿): five bays on two floors, 歇山 in purple-brown tile with green trim (the leaf; Q175); 碧云楼 and 紫霞楼 either side, joined by two-storey galleries (Malone's elevated walks)

At the back (S05 又北為瓊華樓): five bays on two floors under a double top eave, yellow with blue trim (the leaf); 千祥阁 and 万福阁 either side, purple-brown with green trim and two tiers of eaves (the leaf); galleries joining them and running down the court's sides to the middle range (S01, Malone); a terrace behind (S01's rectangle, C)

Flagged; bronze vessels and potted flowering trees before 哕鸾殿 (the leaf; their number and places C); the stair on the axis from the lower terrace (S01; its steps C); the walls round the upper terrace, red with yellow coping, a gate in the west and east walls (S01; colour C; 蕊珠门 is one of the 1740 plaques)

The galleries on their strips out to two stepped cross terraces (S01; Malone: a bridge and two piers to three small terraces) with 集瑞亭 and 凝祥亭: a lower eave and a cross-ridge 十字脊 roof, blue with yellow trim (the leaf); the causeway with two archways 坊座 (S05; places and form C) to the square terrace of 迎薰亭: double eaves, a yellow pyramid roof with a gilt finial (the leaf), four bronzes, two dragons and two phoenixes (E1856; form C), three flights to the water for the barge (S01, Malone)

Every height (the terraces 2.6 and 1.9 m above the water, the upper terrace 3.0 m above the lower, the storeys 3.6 and 3.2 m), every bay's width, the galleries' width and form, the archways, the bronzes, the vessels and trees, the walls' colour, the rear terrace: the hall kit's classes and the Qing manual's typology (C, the pale tint with conf=1). No dig and no Yangshi Lei sheet with figures has been seen (Q119, E1855)

questions.title: Halls in the texts and not on the plan
The gouaches of 1750-92 (S77, P0101-P0140) recolour systematically
The water layer lacks some ponds and inlets the plan and the leaves show

evidence.title: 御製方壺勝境詩（圓明園四十景詩）
evidence.excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製方壺勝境詩
海上三神山舟到風輒引去徒妄語耳要知金銀為宫闕亦何異人寰即境即仙自在我室何事逺求此方壺所為寓名也東為蕊珠宫西則三潭印月淨渌空明又闢一勝境矣
飛觀圖雲鏡水涵拏空松栢與天參高岡翽羽鳴應六曲渚寒蟾印有三魯匠營心非美事齊人搤掔只虛談爭如茅土仙人宅十二金堂比不慙
evidence.summary: Sailors never reach the three sacred isles of the sea, he says, so gold and silver palaces might as well stand here. 蕊珠宫 lies east; 三潭印月 lies to the west on clear water, another fine place.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 方壶胜境
evidence.excerpt_zh: 四宜書屋之東臨池樓宇為方壺勝境上下各五楹南建坊座二其北樓宇為噦鸞殿又北為瓊華樓噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫宫南船塢後有龍王廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按方壺勝境四十景之一額為皇上御書坊座南額曰芝田日永曰閬苑春深北曰鳯鳴珠樹曰鹿夀靈臺方壺勝境樓宇上額曰宜春殿曰敬勝怠噦鸞殿樓宇上額曰用厥中曰有真賞在瓊華樓額曰潄芳潤及蕊珠宫額皆御書
evidence.summary: East of 四宜書屋 on the water: 方壺勝境, five bays on two floors, with two archways to the south, 噦鸞殿 and 瓊華樓 behind, 蕊珠宫 to the east, a boathouse and a 龍王廟. The note gives each plaque.

evidence.title: 方壶胜境: 乾隆七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆七年 (1742), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.269 item (1), under 方壶胜境
evidence.excerpt_zh: 梧竹萧森列几株，文轩长日丽清都。蕉心抽绿画千轴，荷瓣漂红霞一湖。绕栋初闻子母燕，乘波群浴帝王鳬。对时育物歌薫意，兴与诗人别体殊。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 方壶胜境, 1742, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 琼华楼对雨
evidence.locator: v2 p.329, under 方壶胜境; source ref 2-533
evidence.excerpt_zh: 飒爽檐帷生薄寒，梧桐枝上玉阑干。云飞别岫当轩暗，雨过前溪隔座看。声泻池荷吟凤管，点催檐瓦弄珠丸。西山拟望秋晴黛，烟屿鸥波正渺漫。
evidence.summary: Poem 琼华楼对雨 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1742, filed by the editors under 方壶胜境.

evidence.title: 方壶胜境: 乾隆四十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十年 (1775), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.269 item (3), under 方壶胜境
evidence.excerpt_zh:
胜境拟方壶（方壶
胜境为圆明园四十景之一殿居其中），网轩宝额扶。顾名试思义，育物每廑吾。即此春宜者，寜无隅向乎。几闲吟五字，怡与愧犹俱。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 方壶胜境, 1775, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 方壶胜境: 乾隆五十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十四年 (1789), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.270 item (6), under 方壶胜境
evidence.excerpt_zh: 春为元也善之长，惟是一宜无不宜。朵殿顾名每思义，寰区发号必先施。（每于隔岁冬底驰询各省督抚有无偏灾应行加赈之处，至岁首即先颁发恩旨以普春祺。）安怀老㓜常廑彼，彩贴华镫岂乐斯。舒迭群雍奉粤宛，同民台者共登之。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 方壶胜境, 1789, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 方壶胜境
evidence.locator: v2 p.332, under 方壶胜境; source ref 1-174
evidence.excerpt_zh: 载籍徒夸山海异，由来胜境在人间。阁如翔凤雕栏护，桥若飞龙扣砌环。圆峤方壶难玩赏，琪花瑶草漫追攀。应嗤秦汉求仙鄙，徐福扁舟尚未还。
evidence.summary: Poem 方壶胜境 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1796, filed by the editors under 方壶胜境.

evidence.title: 方壶胜境
evidence.locator: v2 p.333, under 方壶胜境; source ref 1-276
evidence.excerpt_zh: 三山无路谁能到，五利文成总妄言。楼阁巍峩拟胜境，神仙缥缈实虚论。餐霞吸雾浮词屏，食德饮和至道存。即此游观为法戒，保民守正示根原。
evidence.summary: Poem 方壶胜境 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1797, filed by the editors under 方壶胜境.

evidence.title: Scene 29, 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing
evidence.excerpt_other: On this terrace there were two large buildings and four smaller side buildings, all of two stories and with elevated walks connecting their second stories.
evidence.summary: Upper brick-faced terrace: two large and four smaller two-storey buildings linked at upper level. Lower terrace on the lake: three two-storey buildings. A bridge and two piers to three small terraces with open pavilions, marble balustrades and steps for the barge. Twelve buildings with golden glazed tile. Built 1740 (Tse Li vol. 2 p.33, vol. 20 p.8). Smaller palace to the east, another across the lake north, boathouse.

evidence.title: Six paintings, III: 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing
evidence.excerpt_other: A l'exception des trois pavillons en saillie sur les eaux, tous les autres bâtiments ont un premier étage.
evidence.summary: Three parallel ranges with upper floors, a quay with three projections carrying pavilions, octagonal paving, a pailou at the foot of the first stair, steps to the water, a long winding gallery over a canal. Fits Malone p.92 closely.

evidence.title: 方壶胜境 南 龙王庙 (S47 section 2.11)
evidence.summary: South of 蕊珠宫 behind the boat dock, north of 涵虚朗鉴 and close to the five-arch sluice: three bays, hanging gable with ridge and finials, facing south; before 1744 by the album.

evidence.title: 清帝笔下的圆明园方壶胜景
evidence.summary: Reads Qianlong's and Jiaqing's poems on 方壶胜境 Fanghu Shengjing, built 1738 in the north-east of 福海. Names the books that describe its plan; notes many building bases survive. No excavation is mentioned.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 方壶胜境
evidence.locator: from p.269, under 方壶胜境
evidence.summary: 方壶胜境: 12 dated items, 1742-1818, of which 12 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1742, last dated 1818.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 方壶胜境
evidence.summary: A temple garden from early Qianlong: on a high terrace in the water the double-eaved 迎薰亭 with 集瑞亭 and 凝祥亭, then three five-bay towers 宜春殿, 哕鸾殿, 琼华楼, each with paired side towers. The note counts 2,235 Buddha images in the nine towers. East court 蕊珠宫; 三潭印月 to the west.

evidence.title: 《圆明园四十景》图的价值: 方壶胜境 leaf
evidence.summary: Says the 方壶胜境 leaf also shows its neighbours: 蕊珠宫 east, the three small stone pagodas and pavilions of 三潭印月 west, 天宇空明 north, two timber bridges south. So one leaf can witness several objects.

evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: earth moved
evidence.summary: One listed change between plans: the hill at 澡身浴德 was removed and earth was added beside 藏舟坞, south-east of 方壶胜境, and east of 三潭印月, spoil from dredging being the usual source. Useful for the hills layer on the east shore.
